newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq reaches new record as broad rally continues.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq reaches new record as broad rally continues.

text.p: The Nasdaq Composite Index reached its second straight record high, as investors continued a three-day buying binge.
The Nasdaq Composite Index gained 11.33 points or 0.86 percent to 1327.73 on Tuesday, topping the record high set Monday.
The Dow industrials rose 33 points to close unofficially at 6601, its second record in two days. The long bond shed 7/32 to yield 6.79 percent.
"It was a very busy, very steady day. There were a lot of stocks participating. Many sectors contributed to this run up," said Jack Bayer, managing director of Oppenheimer & Co.
Traders said they expect the momentum to continue.
Apple Computer Inc continued to trade lower despite assurances from its chairman that the company's turnaround remains on track. Apple lost 3/8 to 17-1/2.
Intel Corp jumped to a new 52-week high of 143-3/8, up 4-1/2. Cisco Systems Inc and Microsoft Corp also posted moderate gains.
Gainers beat losers 2471 to 1885 on total volume of 592 million shares.
